title: The Church
definition: The Church is the people redeemed by Christ, gathered under His lordship, and sent to worship, disciple, serve, and witness in the world.
summary: The Church is the people redeemed by Christ, gathered under His lordship, and sent to worship, disciple, serve, and witness in the world.
christFocus: Jesus is the head, builder, shepherd, and Savior of the Church, giving His people life by the Spirit and uniting them as His body.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Church is not primarily a building, brand, program, or event. Scripture presents the Church as Christ’s redeemed people, called out of darkness and brought together as a holy community under His rule.

The Church gathers for worship, Scripture, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, care, correction, and mission. It also scatters into the world as a witness to the Gospel. Both gathered life and daily faithfulness belong to Christ’s design.

Jesus loves the Church and gave Himself for her. Even when churches fail, wound, or drift, Christ’s design remains good, and His people are called to become a community shaped by His heart.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people have only known church as an institution, performance, or painful memory. Scripture restores the vision of the Church as Christ’s people, where the wounded should find truth, care, restoration, and shared discipleship.

This doctrine also challenges believers who want Jesus without His people. Christ saves individuals into a family, a body, and a mission.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek to understand church through Scripture rather than only through preference or pain. Commit to Christ-centered fellowship where the Word leads, the Spirit works, and people are helped to follow Jesus together.
